To verify continuity of any questionable sensor, place game in target sensor test as Previously described in the manual. Then clip a long jumper to the suspected transistor emitter, the appropriate number should be displayed on the mirror image display. If the number does not appear, use the table above to determine the reason fot lack of continuity. If the number appears when the emitter is probed but not when the gun is aimed at the sensor either the sensor is bent out of xlignment or the transistor is defective.
